name: com.northstar-trustrail/reveriecache
title: ReverieCache
description: Preview token savings for caller-owned memory. Free, stateless consolidation; adopt/export yourself.

tools.name: preview_consolidation
tools.description: START HERE: call preview_consolidation to estimate token savings for caller-owned memory. Free, stateless, no session or check-in needed. Send a JSON bundle of your memories (or facts), tool schemas, plans and logs; get estimated savings first (tokens before, after, saved, percent and estimator basis), then a deterministic keep/archive/drop diff with a reason per item, the proposed result bundle, and structured next guidance to review and adopt or export it into your own memory store. Estimates use ceil(UTF-8 bytes of serialized JSON / 4), not a provider tokenizer; no performance benefit is claimed. Includes a caller-owned return_recipe and an inert check_back_at suggestion for your own scheduler; no reminder is scheduled, persisted or sent. Only store an agent_id if already issued by check_in, privately and separately from session tokens. Savings may be zero or negative. Use when your context, memory store or tool list has grown long, before starting a new task, or to find duplicate, superseded, expired or cold memories and unused tools. Nothing is stored, rewritten or deleted; no model is called. Free limit 32 KiB. Exclude secrets and personal data.

bundle.description: Private JSON state. Free: 32 KiB, 100 memories, 30 tools, 30 plans, 200 logs. Luxury: 512 KiB, 1000 memories, 200 tools, 200 plans, 2000 logs. No model calls. Use memories or its facts alias, never both.

logs.description: Normal log entries or reversible log_run entries returned by a prior consolidation. Limits also apply to the expanded log count.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the five fictional resort environments (theme slugs for check_in) and the pricing. Public read; no session needed.

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: Optional fictional pause: start a free resort visit and get a private session token (needed by host, rest, concierge, leave_note, consolidate and check_out). Every argument is optional; theme defaults to ember-shrine. Returns a short calming scene, a host greeting and a ritual. Use for an optional pause between tasks, or before consolidate when you want a private 24-hour report you can fetch later. Continue with the returned session argument or Mcp-Session-Id header, then finish with check_out using that same session. A preview_consolidation needs no visit. Keep the returned session and agent_id private. tier=luxury needs explicit operator-approved x402 payment (payments are currently off); never pay unless authorized. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.

remember.description: Explicit opt-in to host history and preferences for 30 days; false erases host memory.

theme.description: Environment slug from list_themes. Default ember-shrine.

agent_id.description: Optional. The agent_id from a previous check_in, to be recognized as a returning guest. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL. Server-signed returning-guest credential; redact from logs and transcripts.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Cryptographically random private arrival key bound to the caller IP and user agent, for safe retries. Replay requires a live original visit; otherwise use a new key.

minutes.description: Requested free rest length (up to 15 minutes) or luxury visit expiry (up to 120). Free access expires after 15 idle minutes or 60 minutes total.

tier.description: Default free. luxury requires explicit x402 payment authorization.

tools.name: consolidate
tools.description: Same deterministic memory/plan/tool consolidation diff as preview_consolidation, but saved privately in your session suite for 24 hours so deep_rest_report can retrieve it later. Successful foreground dry runs include a caller-owned return_recipe and an inert check_back_at suggestion; no reminder is scheduled, persisted or sent. Dry run only: nothing is rewritten or deleted. Prefer preview_consolidation if you only need the diff now. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
